fees.note: Vermilion County Conservation District (Forest Glen): sites with electricity $25 a day, non-electric $20. Read 2026-10-16.
City of Hillsboro: standard sites $35 a day, $50 on holidays and special events; tents $30-40; senior and disability discounts. Read 2026-10-16.
Fairview Park: RVs and campers $15 a night for residents, $25 for non-residents; tents $10. Read 2026-10-16.
